lines: Because your smile shines so bright
The orange left behind on my closed eyelids
Became the color of my heart before I knew it
Because you cry so defenselessly
I caught it too and couldn't stop
In the end it was you rubbing my back, wasn't it
Onto the vague thing called love
You traced the outline with those fingers
I can't do anything grand
But I have a few spells to make you smile
My impression of a dog on the way home
The honest words of that day
Talk of your sleep-talking
And a kiss of love
Because you look straight at me
The mess I'd hidden pokes its head out
Before I knew it, you were gently stroking it, weren't you
Onto the uncertain thing called love
You sang the truth with that voice
I have nothing special
But when it comes to spells to make you smile, I have a few
My imitation of your sneezing face — back then, to you
The story of the email I couldn't send, a kiss of love
If a sorrow too heavy to stand under comes for me
If the spell to make you smile disappears
We'll cry together, struggle together, live together
We'll keep searching until we find it — can I call it magic?
I can't do anything grand
But I have a few spells to make you smile
My impression of a dog on the way home, the honest words of that day
Talk of your sleep-talking, and a kiss of love
